title: Forum4Ever1
text:
Forum4Every1 is currently running as Forum4Every1 v1.4. Originally, it was a name for the forum that is now called Boredom Buster!, then I, MinecraftArchitect got the rights to the name, and created Forum4Every1. This forum turned into a failure, and is now known as [DEAD] Forum4Every1. Please see Always Thinking, SamuraiA's blog for more information as to how it got was corrupt. Some of the charges are true, some are false, and some are misinterpretations of various happenings. TO find out more about how it was run, please P.M. MinecraftArchitect.

Forum4Every1 v1.4 has had a rocky start, due to multiple reasons. [list=1] [*] I am trying out some experimental features that MaverickMan has suggested. [*] I am encountering some difficulties with someone who got really upset with some of my policies. [*] I have been having people misunderstand some of my rules. [/list] Aside from these difficulties, it has more potential than the first one.
